attempts.bug_summary: Complete-column encryption is not applied when both complete-column encryption and a plaintext footer are configured. The resulting properties retain the encrypted column map but omit the complete-column-encryption flag, changing behavior only for this combined configuration.

The AAD used to decrypt footer-key column metadata supplies the row-group ordinal as the column ordinal. This can produce incorrect decryption for columns whose ordinal differs from the row-group ordinal, particularly in multi-column or later row groups.

attempts.bug_summary: Bloom-filter length metadata is only copied when a bloom-filter offset is also present. For metadata that provides a length without an offset, the resulting column metadata silently loses the length even though the two fields are independently representable.
